{{Quote|Hutt war-yachts. Livien cutters. Thanium star-glaives. Cronian battlebirds. Spinning and sparring with each other in murderous minuets of their own.|An excerpt from the ''Despotica''|<ref name="Des">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/ximweek04/index.html|text=Xim Week: ''The Despotica'' (Part III: Xim at Vondor)|int=Xim Week: The Despotica}}</ref>}}
'''Thanium star-glaives''' were a model of [[Warship/Legends|warship]] used by the [[Xim's empire|empire]] of the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] despot [[Xim/Legends|Xim]]<ref name="EGTW" /> during its [[Xim Wars|conflict]] with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Des" /> The [[Starship/Legends|starships]] had [[Cigarra/Legends|cigar]]-box shaped hulls with [[chrome]]-colored [[Armor/Legends|armor]] plating attached on slidable girders, allowing the armor to be moved around the ship as needed.<ref name="DW">{{InsiderCite|134|Designing Warships}}</ref> They were fielded in mixed squadrons with other Tionese ships such as [[Argaian hemiolia]]s, [[Cronian battlebird/Legends|Cronian battlebirds]] and [[Livien cutter]]s in battle.<ref name="EGTW" /> Several star-glaives were deployed alongside a [[Xolochi Dreadnought]] in a task force sent to the planet [[Felucia/Legends|Galuch]],<ref name="EGTWX">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> and others fought against Hutt [[Yacht/Legends|yachts]] at the [[First Battle of Vontor|first battle]] at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vontor]], which Xim's forces ultimately lost. The events of the battle were later recorded in the drama known as ''[[The Despotica]]''.<ref name="Des" /> The Thanium star-glaives were normally equipped with torpedoes, concussion missiles, and pulse cannons. The hulls of most star-glaives were armored with kiirium, an alloy completely resistant to energy weapons. Bellow the armored surface, the star-glaive was protected by mytag crystalline vertices. Those protected against electromagnetic pulses.

==Behind the scenes==
Thanium star-glaives first appeared in [[2009]] in the third part of ''[[Xim Week: The Despotica]]'', a series of posts by [[Michael Kogge]] on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]]. They were then mentioned again in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' a [[2012]] reference book by [[Jason Fry]]. The guide also included an image of a star-glaive created by [[Ian Fullwood]], the design process of which was elaborated on in the [[Star Wars Insider 134|''Star Wars Insider'' 134]] article ''[[Designing Warships]]''.
